messages:
maria: Heads up — ClearBank (dedicated pool) just reported P0: sustained p99 ~18s, customer SLA at risk. Observed spike started ~23:15 UTC. Need an engineering lead + immediate short-term mitigations. Who's available?

ajohnson: I'm on it — can take lead for the next 6 hours. I'll coordinate with infra to check pool utilization and pending deploys.

maria: Thanks @ajohnson. Top priorities: 1) identify if KV cache warmup or batching regression; 2) temporary routing to smaller model variant; 3) scale pool if needed. Please propose timeline for each.

ajohnson: Quick plan:
- 10m: confirm top 3 failing routes and sample traces
- 20m: attempt scaling + quick config change (batching window from 20ms -> 10ms)
- 30–60m: rollback recent canary if correlated; enable fallback to gpt-small-quant if latency stays high
I'll need someone to approve pool scale and a code review for the small config tweak.

samir: I can review the config PR ASAP. Also can run the model downgrade test. Not in office after 02:00 UTC though.

linda: Infra — approving emergency scale for ClearBank pool. Runbook says we can auto-scale to +2 GPUs for up to 6 hours. Execute with: `infractl scale --pool=clearbank-prod --delta=2 --ttl=21600`

oncall-bot: Incident #INC-20231111-2345 created for ClearBank P0. Pager duty notified: @maria, @ajohnson.

ajohnson: Started tracing, saw KV cache miss spikes on warmups. Opening PR for batching window change: `https://git/repo/pulls/3421` — @samir PTAL. Also queueing scale command now.

samir: Reviewing PR now, inline comment on retry backoff. Good catch on KV miss — suggest adding a short prefix cache priming job.

maria: Good. For customer comms — @kate (CS) can you send a 30m check-in note to ClearBank with the mitigation steps? We should commit to ETA for a permanent fix within 72h.

kate: On it. Drafting now. I'll send after you confirm scale + downgrade decisions.

ajohnson: Scale kicked, pool up +2 GPUs; observed immediate drop in p95 to ~700ms, p99 still at ~6–7s. Activating model fallback in 5m.

maria: Action items summary:
- Owner: @ajohnson — lead engineering and execute scale + fallback (in progress)
- Reviewer: @samir — config PR review (in progress)
- Infra approval: @linda — approved (done)
- CS comms: @kate — 30m update to customer (pending send)
- Next milestone: confirm p99 <2s within 2h or engage rollback plan
Please ping here when p99 criteria met or if you need escalation. :thumbsup:

ajohnson: Will update in 10m with post-fallback metrics.

maria: Thanks team — if anyone is blocked, call the on-call phone or add notes here. We'll schedule a 15m sync in 45m if this persists.
